why_it_fails: resolution/website discovery: fallback search returned NO_LEAD. Stored evidence shows html.duckduckgo.com answers HTTP 202 with a bot challenge and www.bing.com/search answers 200 with unrelated Microsoft pages for the quoted-address query, so no candidate website is ever found even though the brand site exists. Once found, this is the Dutchie browser path (docs/DUTCHIE_DIAGNOSIS.md); the first-party /api-0/graphql host differs from dutchie.com, so platform detection must key on assets2.dutchie.com + dispensaryId, not the dutchie.com hostname.
fix_idea: Replace the fallback search with a working source (e.g. the OpenRouter web plugin the verifier already uses, or a brand-level locator) and treat a results page where nothing names the store as a search failure, not 'no lead'. Add a Dutchie Plus signature (/stores/<slug>, /api-0/graphql, dispensary_id in telemetry).
